thesis: The episode discusses the evolution of Campbell & Company from a pure trend-following firm in the early 2000s to a systematic multi-strategy manager employing over 100 alpha signals across four major styles: quant macro, short-term trend, and equity market neutral. The conversation highlights the firm's expansion beyond liquid futures markets to include cash equities and a broader conception of investment styles and time horizons.
